note: T04 fixture C - golden budget admission rows over identical request content across two routes. 'oversizedSystemChars' grows only the system text; the canonical estimate is ceiling(chars/4) over the T02 budgetProjection. Rows are recomputed with Overflow.ContextBudget.evaluate using the frozen constants (G=16384, M=4096, H=20480, reserve floor 20000). The cross-route qualifier is providerID+modelID: the identical oversized request must be rejected on the small route and admitted on the large route, and the T04 gate must produce zero provider calls on the rejected route.

oversized.note: system[1] is replaced by 'D' x oversizedSystemChars (deterministic growth); everything else identical

compaction.note: agent.name = 'compaction'; same normal content; expected Oc = min(4096, route output 32000) = 4096

normalSmall.note: context limit binds: inputBudget = 32000 - max(20000, 20480) = 11520; contextBudget = 32000 - max(20000, 4096+20480) = 7424; B = 7424

oversizedLarge.note: identical oversized request is admissible on the larger route - the qualifier is route-local
